summary.intent: Plan phase 49 (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation unwrap consolidation), execute the implementation, then run full PR-QA (simplify, security-review, CodeRabbit CLI) before pushing and opening a PR.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully: 5 plans across 3 waves covering all 6 requirements (scope expanded from 5 to include batch+drag move), plan-checker passed after one revision round. Execution began with Wave 1 dispatched but transcript ends mid-execution.

repo: `reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange` (reencrypt.ts:49) is fully key-agnostic — takes raw sourceFolderKey/destFolderKey/fileIpnsPrivateKey, reusable verbatim for the shared-folder move case.
`share_keys` entries are keyed by itemId (file UUID), not parent folder — file keys do NOT need re-registration after a move. Download path resolves by `k.keyType === 'file' && k.itemId === item.id`.

`adoptSharedFolderResult` emits `sharedFolder:updated` with `live.ipnsName` (always source depth). Calling it for the dest result would corrupt the rendered view — correct design is source-only adoption.
`sdkCore.moveItem` throws 'An item with this name already exists in destination' on collision (sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts:346). No auto-rename — propagates through `runWrite` → `p.setError`.
`@internal` on `ensureFolderLoaded` is documentation-only since `CipherBoxClient` is already exported. Can call it directly from the web without adding a new public alias.
`SharedFolderClient` Pick allowlist (shared-folder-projection.ts:28-38) lists only the 7 Phase 48 methods — `moveInSharedFolder` and `enumerateSharedSubtree` must be added.

File IPNS key for re-encryption must come from `share_keys keyType:'file-ipns'`, NOT `FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` (owner-wrapped; recipients cannot decrypt it). Same pattern as `updateSharedFileHandler`.

Batch move is a web-layer pattern only — `useFileBrowserActions` selection Set → `handleBatchMoveConfirm` → `useFolderMutations.handleMoveItems` — loops single-item `client.moveItem`. No dedicated SDK batch method.
Drag move lives in `FileListItem`: `handleDragStart` (multi-select-aware) → drop target on folder rows → `handleDropOnFolder` → `moveItem`/`moveItems`. Shared side has none of this today.
`useSharedWriteOps.test.ts` already exists and can be extended with a `moveItemHandler` unit test rather than creating a new file.
Intel API surface extractor regex is unpopulated — produces empty output. RESEARCH.md with verified symbol refs is sufficient as planner input; skip the intel regen step when it returns nothing.

code.finding: `reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange` takes raw key bytes (sourceFolderKey, destFolderKey, fileIpnsPrivateKey) — no owner vs. recipient distinction, safe to call for shared-folder moves.
Collision policy is throw: 'An item with this name already exists in destination'. No auto-rename path exists.
Pick allowlist only contains Phase 48 methods. Phase 49 must add `moveInSharedFolder` and `enumerateSharedSubtree` here.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI review (`coderabbit review --agent`) must run BEFORE PR creation. After the PR is opened, CodeRabbit posts a separate GitHub review automatically — address that with `/resolve-pr-reviews`.

Plan-checker is worth running: it caught a real gap (REQ-3 web handler had no unit test, making its verification vacuous) that the planner missed. Two other findings were doc-formatting nits fixable without re-planning.
Sequential execution (no parallel worktrees) is the correct AFK choice: parallel-worktree merge-back protocol has documented cwd-drift and merge-base footguns that make unattended runs fragile.
When the `gsd-executor` subagent lacks `gsd-tools` on PATH, it cannot commit planning artifacts — the orchestrator must commit those manually after the subagent completes.

Disabling `commit.gpgsign` locally (`git config --local commit.gpgsign false`) is required for AFK automated commits when the global git config uses 1Password signing — prevents the signer from wedging the session.

friction: AI-SPEC gate false-positived on the word 'eval' in the e2e requirement text, requiring manual triage to confirm zero actual AI content.
1Password commit signing would block all automated AFK commits — required a local `commit.gpgsign=false` override and will need a signed rebase before the PR can merge.
`gsd-tools` binary not on PATH inside the planner-revision subagent, preventing it from committing its own artifacts — orchestrator had to commit manually.
Intel surface regen produces empty output (unpopulated regex extractor) — a no-op step that adds latency without value.

Plan-checker iteration required two passes (2 blockers + 1 warning on first pass); the research doc nits that triggered blocker 1 and the warning were formatting issues that should have been caught before submission.
open_items: Branch commits are unsigned (gpgsign disabled for session) — a signed rebase or admin override is required before the PR can merge into main.
UI safety gate was skipped with `--skip-ui` (shared MoveDialog mirrors private design); `gsd:ui-review` retroactive validation still needed during QA.
Phase execution is incomplete — Wave 1 was just dispatched (0/5 plans done) when the transcript ends. Waves 2 and 3 (web single-item, batch+drag, e2e) remain.
After PR creation: wait for CodeRabbit GitHub review to post, then run `/resolve-pr-reviews` to address inline comments.
Scope was expanded mid-planning to include batch+drag move in the shared view (new REQ-6) — this is net-new functionality with no prior shared-side implementation and needs careful QA.
